text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The gambler Umamusume, Nakayama Festa. 
Seeking the tingling thrill that only a 
razor-thin contest could provide, and that 
palpable sense of feeling "alive"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa... You crashed the press 
conference of the runner-up in the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe, the "Umamusume closest 
to the world." You challenged her—and 
suffered a crushing defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who took on a "reckless" 
challenge. Labeling her as such, reporters 
cast curious glances her way. Yet even 
that was pure pleasure to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In search of the most thrilling match of 
all, the challenge of aiming for the world 
alongside her was about to begin.
